instance_branding.purpose: One installation branding configuration: name, colors, logo metadata and revision.

platform_grants.purpose: Explicit operator authority; institution administration does not imply this grant.

institution_audit_events.purpose: Institution-scoped attributed audit events for supported commands.

institution_invitations.purpose: Seven-day single-use institution invitation hashes, roles and sport metadata.

institution_members.purpose: Institution membership, one role, active/revoked state, primary-coach mirror and revision.

institution_operations.purpose: Exact actor/institution-scoped command payload and response receipts.

institutions.purpose: Persistent institution identity and historical scope keys; one institution is supported per installation.

institution_assignments.purpose: Athlete assignment to an immutable program version, date range, goal/sport and independent sequence cursor.

institution_exercises.purpose: Institution-authored exercise metadata and visibility to authorized staff.

institution_programs.purpose: Editable institution program drafts, publication/library state and revision.

institution_sessions.purpose: Athlete workout document, prescription/actual results, recorder attribution and optional scoped occurrence link.

institution_versions.purpose: Immutable published institution program snapshots referenced by assignments and history.

program_media.purpose: Institution program artwork metadata and private-byte identity.

assessment_result_history.purpose: Attributed previous versions of participant assessment scores.

assessment_results.purpose: Current per-participant assessment scores and notes, separate from attendance/workout actuals.

assessment_templates.purpose: Reusable assessment definitions, units, bounds and version.

institution_event_people.purpose: Frozen event roster, staff/athlete duty, attendance and participant revision.

institution_events.purpose: Timed institution training/assessment occurrences and explicit day-only individual workouts, frozen prescription, staff/athlete roster and local training date.

institution_group_members.purpose: Current institution group membership; does not rewrite historical event rosters.

institution_groups.purpose: Institution groups used to select participants and coaches.

institution_sports.purpose: Institution sports and coaching specialties, ordered and archived explicitly.

institution_coaching_links.purpose: Primary/supporting coach relationships with sport scope and attribution/history.

institution_session_history.purpose: Attributed workout actual-result versions; corrections retain history.

institution_channel_members.purpose: Private/group channel authority and membership snapshots.

institution_channels.purpose: Institution direct-pair/group conversation identity with distinct access rules.

institution_messages.purpose: Institution message body, sender and attachment compatibility reference.

institution_message_assets.purpose: Ordered many-attachment links for institution messages.

notification_events.purpose: Per-user notification inbox and delivery checkpoints; not proof of external delivery.

notification_intercepts.purpose: Local delivery-adapter interception evidence, not a production email service.

notification_preferences.purpose: Explicit user category/channel preferences and quiet hours.

platform_identity_state.purpose: Operator-managed account suspension state independent from institution role.

platform_operations.purpose: Exact operator write receipts and actor attribution.

institution_meal_history.purpose: Attributed previous versions of actual nutrition entries.

institution_meals.purpose: Athlete actual consumption entries, kept separate from suggested meal plans.

institution_nutrition_plans.purpose: Institution nutrition guidance snapshots assigned to an athlete.

institution_nutrition_sharing.purpose: Athlete authorization and revision for coach visibility of actual nutrition records.

institution_assets.purpose: Institution file ownership, scope/purpose, channel boundary and byte lifecycle.

institution_session_feedback.purpose: Explicit athlete ratings tied to a workout or event; missing feedback is unknown.

institution_workplace_feedback.purpose: Explicit monthly coach workplace feedback; distinct from athlete experience.

institution_injury_permissions.purpose: Product consent/assent prerequisites and withdrawal checkpoints for participation-status sharing.

institution_injury_records.purpose: Athlete-authored non-diagnostic participation restrictions; not general administrator-visible medical records.

institution_injury_history.purpose: Attributed historical versions of participation restrictions.

institution_injury_operations.purpose: Hash-only exact health-write acknowledgments; sensitive request content is not copied into receipts.

institution_injury_retention_checkpoint.purpose: Non-identifying aggregate checkpoints for closed-record retention cleanup.

institution_workout_positions.purpose: Assignment sequence position/cycle, occurrence/workout links and attributed once-only resolution.

institution_workout_recurrences.purpose: Opt-in bounded weekly/today-only preparation policies with current authority, poll checkpoints, last materialized day and general scheduling diagnostics.

reference_exercises.purpose: Canonical shared exercise reference metadata; institution-authored exercises are separate.

institution_workout_templates.purpose: Versioned institution-shared single-workout prescriptions. Scheduled group and program imports own frozen copies; archive does not delete history.
